_comment: PLAN.md phase 2 step 2: each class's authored ability, built into NjordlingerCombatGameplayOverhaul.esp by tools/PluginBuild.
The shape follows Apprentice's class bonuses (CLASS-MAP.md section 1, reference only - no record of theirs is used).
An entry with effects becomes a constant self ability (one Value Modifier magic effect per effect, carrying the class
keyword); an entry with none gets no ability yet - its bonus needs a perk or a conditioned effect and is listed as
a stub (TUNE). av: the Mutagen ActorValue name. magnitude: the value added while the ability is held.
